name: Rude
overview: Scripture teaches that rudeness, expressed through harsh or thoughtless words, stirs up anger and is contrary to godly wisdom and humility. A soft and gentle response can turn away wrath, while a wise person restrains their speech rather than uttering everything impulsively. Believers are called to avoid speaking evil or engaging in strife, instead showing meekness and esteeming others above themselves, reflecting the character of Christ in all interactions.
